After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. Paul's initials attempts to cheer him up are unsuccessful, but not one to admit defeat he sets about entertaining Visu with his stand-up routine, only to be snubbed once more.

programme.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs

Along the way, free-roaming leopards, great flocks of cranes and the ever-present sacred cow ensure that no two kilometres are ever quite the same.

programme.title: Cleopatra: Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.sub-title: Cleopatra: The Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.desc: A renowned American collector might hold the key to the mysterious tomb. He recently discovered a perfectly preserved mummified hand, brought back from Egypt in the 18th century. If the accompanying text is to be believed, it is that of Cleopatra VII, the last Queen Pharaoh of this vanished civilization. Could it be true? A thrilling investigation begins to solve a 2,000-year-old enigma.

programme.desc: Allied forces were evacuated off Crete's south coast in a dangerous operation that cost the lives of almost 1000 British seamen and Allied soldiers. Protected by a series of bloody and heroic rear-guard actions to slow down the German advance, thousands of soldiers embarked on a forced march over the mountains of central Crete to meet Royal Navy ships which would take them 400 miles across the Mediterranean to Alexandria in Egypt.

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar

Built in the 11th century by William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy who became King of England, England's first stone keep was transformed two centuries later into a magnificent royal residence.

programme.title: Snowpiercer

When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Private Desert
programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.title: Cleopatra: Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.sub-title: Cleopatra: The Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.desc: A renowned American collector might hold the key to the mysterious tomb. He recently discovered a perfectly preserved mummified hand, brought back from Egypt in the 18th century. If the accompanying text is to be believed, it is that of Cleopatra VII, the last Queen Pharaoh of this vanished civilization. Could it be true? A thrilling investigation begins to solve a 2,000-year-old enigma.

programme.title: The Battle Of Crete
programme.desc: Allied forces were evacuated off Crete's south coast in a dangerous operation that cost the lives of almost 1000 British seamen and Allied soldiers. Protected by a series of bloody and heroic rear-guard actions to slow down the German advance, thousands of soldiers embarked on a forced march over the mountains of central Crete to meet Royal Navy ships which would take them 400 miles across the Mediterranean to Alexandria in Egypt.

programme.title: SBS World News

programme.title: Magical Train Journeys In Switzerland
programme.sub-title: With The Voralpen-express From St Gallen To Lucerne
programme.desc: From the rolling hills of Appenzellerland across Lake Zurich to vibrant Lucerne, the journey with the Voralpenexpress offers unique panoramas on its way from the east to central Switzerland and an insight into the historic architecture of the Swiss railroad pioneers.

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar
programme.desc: Elizabeth was the first A-list celebrity to open the doors to the public, sharing all the drama of her life and relationships with the world and, in the process, invented the modern celebrity.

programme.title: The Wonders Of Europe
programme.desc: Famous for its ravens and the Crown Jewels, the Tower of London attracts more than three million visitors every year. Built in the 11th century by William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy who became King of England, England's first stone keep was transformed two centuries later into a magnificent royal residence.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: As the bomber is revealed, Layton comes to terms with his past decisions before making an irreversible call.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dr Will Caster, the world's foremost authority on artificial intelligence, is conducting highly controversial experiments to create a sentient machine. When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Private Desert
programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programme.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programme.title: Instant Italian

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Usa
programme.desc: Bill and Paul ride into their hometown of Bryan-College Station Texas, where the town is being over run by Wild Boars. They head out on a night hunt with state-of-the-art military-grade equipment and Bill bags a big pig. Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.title: Jamie's Super Food
programme.desc: On the Greek island of Ikaria Jamie finds out how wholegrain cracked wheat- which could be one of the reasons local people live so long - is prepared the traditional way and helps make Trahana.

programme.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programme.desc: Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk. However, until quite recently, the only specialist cheeses available in the country came from Europe.

Adam shares this treat with author Michael Booth who gives him an insight into the differences between the Nordic countries.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Global food explorer Adam is touring Britain, one incredible, edible place at a time, using the map as his menu to try the best food found here. Paul's initials attempts to cheer him up are unsuccessful, but not one to admit defeat he sets about entertaining Visu with his stand-up routine, only to be snubbed once more.

programme.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs

Paul helps them try solid food for the first time, after being hand reared by staff at Battersea since birth, given bottles every two hours day and night. programme.sub-title: With The Voralpen-express From St Gallen To Lucerne

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar
programme.desc: Elizabeth was the first A-list celebrity to open the doors to the public, sharing all the drama of her life and relationships with the world and, in the process, invented the modern celebrity.

programme.title: The Wonders Of Europe
programme.desc: Famous for its ravens and the Crown Jewels, the Tower of London attracts more than three million visitors every year. Built in the 11th century by William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy who became King of England, England's first stone keep was transformed two centuries later into a magnificent royal residence.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: As the bomber is revealed, Layton comes to terms with his past decisions before making an irreversible call.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dr Will Caster, the world's foremost authority on artificial intelligence, is conducting highly controversial experiments to create a sentient machine. When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Private Desert
programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programme.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programme.title: Instant Italian
programme.desc: Anna's throwing an Italian Snacking Party and showing how to make her guests' favorite make-ahead snacks, such as Sicilian-style Chicken Spiedini and Neapolitan Fried Eggplant Sandwiches.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Usa
programme.desc: Bill and Paul ride into their hometown of Bryan-College Station Texas, where the town is being over run by Wild Boars. They head out on a night hunt with state-of-the-art military-grade equipment and Bill bags a big pig. Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.title: Jamie's Super Food
programme.desc: On the Greek island of Ikaria Jamie finds out how wholegrain cracked wheat- which could be one of the reasons local people live so long - is prepared the traditional way and helps make Trahana.

programme.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
programme.sub-title: Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar
programme.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me: The Professionals
programme.desc: Today we're in and around Birmingham and Wolverhampton and first up is Adians Dining where chef Adian and fiance and front of house manager Eloise are showcasing their Caribbean-Asian fusion menu.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Fillers

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk. However, until quite recently, the only specialist cheeses available in the country came from Europe.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia
programme.desc: Adam and Meik Wiking, the Director of The Happiness Institute, together cook the national Danish dish, Stegt Flaesk, and discuss how Denmark is the happiest country in the world. Adam ventures into top chef Christian Puglisi's kitchen at Michelin star restaurant Relae, before visiting a pastry chef to make a traditional Danish pastry, Spandauer. Adam shares this treat with author Michael Booth who gives him an insight into the differences between the Nordic countries.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Global food explorer Adam is touring Britain, one incredible, edible place at a time, using the map as his menu to try the best food found here. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. programme.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs
programme.desc: Paul meets Visu, an eight-year-old Shih Tzu brought to Battersea by his owner who is too ill to look after him. Visu doesn't adapt well to life at Battersea and won't eat, sleep or mix with the other dogs. Paul's initials attempts to cheer him up are unsuccessful, but not one to admit defeat he sets about entertaining Visu with his stand-up routine, only to be snubbed once more.

programme.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs
programme.desc: Paul catches up with the Jack Russell and Staffie cross puppies he met earlier in the series. Now nearly four weeks old, the adorable puppies are all thriving and ready to be weaned. Paul helps them try solid food for the first time, after being hand reared by staff at Battersea since birth, given bottles every two hours day and night. Despite one of the pups taking a toilet break under Paul's leg yet again, he is still smitten and fighting the urge to take them home.

programme.title: Hot Roads: World's Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Rajasthan is a state of ancient palaces, vast desert landscapes and roads that are fast-paced, chaotic and utterly unpredictable. Travelling by truck, bus, autorickshaw and dromedary, this is a journey from the Aravalli Mountains to the Thar Desert. Along the way, free-roaming leopards, great flocks of cranes and the ever-present sacred cow ensure that no two kilometres are ever quite the same.

programme.desc: Ernie cruises the ancient waterways of Danggu Gorge, Aaron catches up with a talented woodcarver in QLD's sugarcane country and Narelda tries her hand at natural horsemanship in regional Victoria.

programme.title: Stories From The Cities
programme.desc: Stories from the Cities journeys across Canada, Mexico, and the United States, exploring the host cities of the FIFA World Cup 2026. In this episode, we discover the footballing spirit of the San Francisco Bay Area through its people, neighbourhoods, culture, and the everyday moments that define the city.

programme.title: Cleopatra: Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.sub-title: Cleopatra: The Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.desc: A renowned American collector might hold the key to the mysterious tomb. He recently discovered a perfectly preserved mummified hand, brought back from Egypt in the 18th century. If the accompanying text is to be believed, it is that of Cleopatra VII, the last Queen Pharaoh of this vanished civilization. Could it be true? A thrilling investigation begins to solve a 2,000-year-old enigma.

programme.title: Giro D'italia 2026 Highlights
programme.desc: Highlights from Stage 13 of the 2026 Giro d'Italia, as the peloton takes on a 188 km route starting in Alessandria and finishing in Verbania.

programme.title: The Battle Of Crete
programme.desc: Allied forces were evacuated off Crete's south coast in a dangerous operation that cost the lives of almost 1000 British seamen and Allied soldiers. Protected by a series of bloody and heroic rear-guard actions to slow down the German advance, thousands of soldiers embarked on a forced march over the mountains of central Crete to meet Royal Navy ships which would take them 400 miles across the Mediterranean to Alexandria in Egypt.

programme.title: SBS World News
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Jewels Of The Mediterranean
programme.desc: With its 11 months of sunshine, this episode explores Cyprus. A village is taken over by a Cypriot Wedding, the Fella Twins create a new Kolokasi recipe, we find the secret to the perfect halloumi and meet the women stitching Cyprus back together.

programme.title: Magical Train Journeys In Switzerland
programme.sub-title: With The Voralpen-express From St Gallen To Lucerne
programme.desc: From the rolling hills of Appenzellerland across Lake Zurich to vibrant Lucerne, the journey with the Voralpenexpress offers unique panoramas on its way from the east to central Switzerland and an insight into the historic architecture of the Swiss railroad pioneers.

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar
programme.desc: Elizabeth was the first A-list celebrity to open the doors to the public, sharing all the drama of her life and relationships with the world and, in the process, invented the modern celebrity.

programme.title: The Wonders Of Europe
programme.desc: Famous for its ravens and the Crown Jewels, the Tower of London attracts more than three million visitors every year. Built in the 11th century by William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy who became King of England, England's first stone keep was transformed two centuries later into a magnificent royal residence.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: As the bomber is revealed, Layton comes to terms with his past decisions before making an irreversible call.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dr Will Caster, the world's foremost authority on artificial intelligence, is conducting highly controversial experiments to create a sentient machine. When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Private Desert
programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programme.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programme.title: Instant Italian
programme.desc: Anna's throwing an Italian Snacking Party and showing how to make her guests' favorite make-ahead snacks, such as Sicilian-style Chicken Spiedini and Neapolitan Fried Eggplant Sandwiches.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Usa
programme.desc: Bill and Paul ride into their hometown of Bryan-College Station Texas, where the town is being over run by Wild Boars. They head out on a night hunt with state-of-the-art military-grade equipment and Bill bags a big pig. Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.title: Jamie's Super Food
programme.desc: On the Greek island of Ikaria Jamie finds out how wholegrain cracked wheat- which could be one of the reasons local people live so long - is prepared the traditional way and helps make Trahana.

programme.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
programme.sub-title: Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar
programme.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me: The Professionals
programme.desc: Today we're in and around Birmingham and Wolverhampton and first up is Adians Dining where chef Adian and fiance and front of house manager Eloise are showcasing their Caribbean-Asian fusion menu.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Fillers
programme.desc: Hosts Adam Liaw, Renee Lim and Lily Serna meet passionate growers, celebrated chefs and local food heroes from all over Australia.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a night of sensational seafood as Adam and his world-class guests, swimmer Ariarne Titmus and chef Alejandro Saravia, share how they reel in a crowd.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk. However, until quite recently, the only specialist cheeses available in the country came from Europe.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia
programme.desc: Adam and Meik Wiking, the Director of The Happiness Institute, together cook the national Danish dish, Stegt Flaesk, and discuss how Denmark is the happiest country in the world. Adam ventures into top chef Christian Puglisi's kitchen at Michelin star restaurant Relae, before visiting a pastry chef to make a traditional Danish pastry, Spandauer. Adam shares this treat with author Michael Booth who gives him an insight into the differences between the Nordic countries.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Global food explorer Adam is touring Britain, one incredible, edible place at a time, using the map as his menu to try the best food found here. He’s travelled to Scone in Scotland for a taste of the tattie scone. He also visits a top restaurant in Perth for Scotland's national dish, the famous haggis, neeps and tatties.

programme.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programme.desc: Buddy makes a cake for an old friend and the current Editorial Director of House Beautiful Magazine, Joanna Saltz. Meanwhile, when Danny The Mule announces his retirement.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programme.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Chilli Crab, Chilli Fish, Fried Rice, Shellfish Salad
programme.desc: Mitch and Ali travel 140 kms north of Broome to Mercedes Cove, a must-visit tourist destination to take in the amazing country, with William Bin Kali and -Petronella Channing.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: In this episode, Rachel is coming in strong with this flavorful Pork Chop Pizzaiola recipe made with blistered tomatoes, onions and garlic cooked a la plancha style.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: From the banks of Adelaide's beautiful River Torrens, Laura cooks a superb pasta dish of Garganelli with Braised Greens. Then we're up to tropical Noosa with Matt, who cooks a light, quick, and refreshing dish of Falafel Pitas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves to prepare simple recipes with the freshest of seafood. She creates halibut with saffron fregola, tuna chickpea salad, and shares a recipe moment with her grandson, Miles.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: In this concluding episode, Tom recalls life as a young chef in the competitive world of the professional kitchen.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: There are few people who can resist a sweet treat. Especially when it's an authentic, Italian offering. From biscotti to an espresso swirl cake, Silvia's twist on classic recipes are sure to delight.

programme.title: Food Safari
programme.desc: Maeve O'Meara discovers some of the vast range of flavours and dishes that can be found across the USA. And Californian expatriate John Boland shows Maeve how to make his renowned Californian fish tacos.

programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain makes her family favourite dishes, perfect to indulge in on those treat days.

programme.title: River Cottage Vegetables
programme.desc: Hugh sets up a vegetable garden and then meets top vegetarian chef David Bailey.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Jumping into a Thai tuk tuk taxi, Tony attempts to soak up Thai culture, and get lost in the cuisine of Chiang Mai, Thailand.

Paul's initials attempts to cheer him up are unsuccessful, but not one to admit defeat he sets about entertaining Visu with his stand-up routine, only to be snubbed once more.

programme.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs
programme.desc: Paul catches up with the Jack Russell and Staffie cross puppies he met earlier in the series. Now nearly four weeks old, the adorable puppies are all thriving and ready to be weaned. Paul helps them try solid food for the first time, after being hand reared by staff at Battersea since birth, given bottles every two hours day and night. programme.title: The Wonders Of Europe
programme.desc: Famous for its ravens and the Crown Jewels, the Tower of London attracts more than three million visitors every year. Built in the 11th century by William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy who became King of England, England's first stone keep was transformed two centuries later into a magnificent royal residence.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: As the bomber is revealed, Layton comes to terms with his past decisions before making an irreversible call.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dr Will Caster, the world's foremost authority on artificial intelligence, is conducting highly controversial experiments to create a sentient machine. When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Private Desert
programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize

programme.desc: Bill and Paul ride into their hometown of Bryan-College Station Texas, where the town is being over run by Wild Boars. They head out on a night hunt with state-of-the-art military-grade equipment and Bill bags a big pig. Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programme.desc: Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk. However, until quite recently, the only specialist cheeses available in the country came from Europe.

Adam shares this treat with author Michael Booth who gives him an insight into the differences between the Nordic countries.

A thrilling investigation begins to solve a 2,000-year-old enigma.

Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

Paul's initials attempts to cheer him up are unsuccessful, but not one to admit defeat he sets about entertaining Visu with his stand-up routine, only to be snubbed once more.

programme.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs

Paul helps them try solid food for the first time, after being hand reared by staff at Battersea since birth, given bottles every two hours day and night. Despite one of the pups taking a toilet break under Paul's leg yet again, he is still smitten and fighting the urge to take them home.

Travelling by truck, bus, autorickshaw and dromedary, this is a journey from the Aravalli Mountains to the Thar Desert. Along the way, free-roaming leopards, great flocks of cranes and the ever-present sacred cow ensure that no two kilometres are ever quite the same.

In this episode, we discover the footballing spirit of the San Francisco Bay Area through its people, neighbourhoods, culture, and the everyday moments that define the city.

programme.title: Cleopatra: Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.sub-title: Cleopatra: The Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.desc: A renowned American collector might hold the key to the mysterious tomb. He recently discovered a perfectly preserved mummified hand, brought back from Egypt in the 18th century. If the accompanying text is to be believed, it is that of Cleopatra VII, the last Queen Pharaoh of this vanished civilization. Could it be true? A thrilling investigation begins to solve a 2,000-year-old enigma.

programme.title: The Battle Of Crete
programme.desc: Allied forces were evacuated off Crete's south coast in a dangerous operation that cost the lives of almost 1000 British seamen and Allied soldiers. Protected by a series of bloody and heroic rear-guard actions to slow down the German advance, thousands of soldiers embarked on a forced march over the mountains of central Crete to meet Royal Navy ships which would take them 400 miles across the Mediterranean to Alexandria in Egypt.

programme.title: SBS World News
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Magical Train Journeys In Switzerland
programme.sub-title: With The Voralpen-express From St Gallen To Lucerne
programme.desc: From the rolling hills of Appenzellerland across Lake Zurich to vibrant Lucerne, the journey with the Voralpenexpress offers unique panoramas on its way from the east to central Switzerland and an insight into the historic architecture of the Swiss railroad pioneers.

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar
programme.desc: Elizabeth was the first A-list celebrity to open the doors to the public, sharing all the drama of her life and relationships with the world and, in the process, invented the modern celebrity.

programme.title: The Wonders Of Europe
programme.desc: Famous for its ravens and the Crown Jewels, the Tower of London attracts more than three million visitors every year. Built in the 11th century by William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy who became King of England, England's first stone keep was transformed two centuries later into a magnificent royal residence.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: As the bomber is revealed, Layton comes to terms with his past decisions before making an irreversible call.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dr Will Caster, the world's foremost authority on artificial intelligence, is conducting highly controversial experiments to create a sentient machine. When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Private Desert
programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.sub-title: Cleopatra: The Mystery Of The Mummified Hand

If the accompanying text is to be believed, it is that of Cleopatra VII, the last Queen Pharaoh of this vanished civilization. Could it be true? A thrilling investigation begins to solve a 2,000-year-old enigma.

Protected by a series of bloody and heroic rear-guard actions to slow down the German advance, thousands of soldiers embarked on a forced march over the mountains of central Crete to meet Royal Navy ships which would take them 400 miles across the Mediterranean to Alexandria in Egypt.

For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!

programme.title: Banel & Adama

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

Paul's initials attempts to cheer him up are unsuccessful, but not one to admit defeat he sets about entertaining Visu with his stand-up routine, only to be snubbed once more.

programme.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs
programme.desc: Paul catches up with the Jack Russell and Staffie cross puppies he met earlier in the series. Now nearly four weeks old, the adorable puppies are all thriving and ready to be weaned. Paul helps them try solid food for the first time, after being hand reared by staff at Battersea since birth, given bottles every two hours day and night. Despite one of the pups taking a toilet break under Paul's leg yet again, he is still smitten and fighting the urge to take them home.

programme.title: Hot Roads: World's Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Rajasthan is a state of ancient palaces, vast desert landscapes and roads that are fast-paced, chaotic and utterly unpredictable. Travelling by truck, bus, autorickshaw and dromedary, this is a journey from the Aravalli Mountains to the Thar Desert. Along the way, free-roaming leopards, great flocks of cranes and the ever-present sacred cow ensure that no two kilometres are ever quite the same.

programme.title: Stories From The Cities
programme.desc: Stories from the Cities journeys across Canada, Mexico, and the United States, exploring the host cities of the FIFA World Cup 2026. In this episode, we discover the footballing spirit of the San Francisco Bay Area through its people, neighbourhoods, culture, and the everyday moments that define the city.

programme.title: Cleopatra: Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.sub-title: Cleopatra: The Mystery Of The Mummified Hand
programme.desc: A renowned American collector might hold the key to the mysterious tomb. He recently discovered a perfectly preserved mummified hand, brought back from Egypt in the 18th century. If the accompanying text is to be believed, it is that of Cleopatra VII, the last Queen Pharaoh of this vanished civilization. Could it be true? A thrilling investigation begins to solve a 2,000-year-old enigma.

programme.title: Giro D'italia 2026 Highlights
programme.desc: Highlights from Stage 13 of the 2026 Giro d'Italia, as the peloton takes on a 188 km route starting in Alessandria and finishing in Verbania.

programme.title: The Battle Of Crete
programme.desc: Allied forces were evacuated off Crete's south coast in a dangerous operation that cost the lives of almost 1000 British seamen and Allied soldiers. Protected by a series of bloody and heroic rear-guard actions to slow down the German advance, thousands of soldiers embarked on a forced march over the mountains of central Crete to meet Royal Navy ships which would take them 400 miles across the Mediterranean to Alexandria in Egypt.

programme.title: SBS World News
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Jewels Of The Mediterranean
programme.desc: With its 11 months of sunshine, this episode explores Cyprus. A village is taken over by a Cypriot Wedding, the Fella Twins create a new Kolokasi recipe, we find the secret to the perfect halloumi and meet the women stitching Cyprus back together.

programme.title: Magical Train Journeys In Switzerland
programme.sub-title: With The Voralpen-express From St Gallen To Lucerne
programme.desc: From the rolling hills of Appenzellerland across Lake Zurich to vibrant Lucerne, the journey with the Voralpenexpress offers unique panoramas on its way from the east to central Switzerland and an insight into the historic architecture of the Swiss railroad pioneers.

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar
programme.desc: Elizabeth was the first A-list celebrity to open the doors to the public, sharing all the drama of her life and relationships with the world and, in the process, invented the modern celebrity.

programme.title: The Wonders Of Europe
programme.desc: Famous for its ravens and the Crown Jewels, the Tower of London attracts more than three million visitors every year. Built in the 11th century by William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy who became King of England, England's first stone keep was transformed two centuries later into a magnificent royal residence.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: As the bomber is revealed, Layton comes to terms with his past decisions before making an irreversible call.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dr Will Caster, the world's foremost authority on artificial intelligence, is conducting highly controversial experiments to create a sentient machine. When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed - to be a participant in his own transcendence. Stars Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Four's A Crowd
programme.desc: Julian is a fifty-year-old divorcee. After starting to use a car-sharing app to help with his financial problems, he meets Lorena, a young girl who frequently travels to Madrid. For the past few months, Lorena has had a permanent place in Julian's car, and more recently, in his heart. Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programme.desc: A widowed British businessman takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife alive.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: In a remote Senegalese village, Banel and Adama’s intense love defies tradition, but their passion soon clashes with a world where order rules and chaos has no place.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Private Desert
programme.desc: Daniel has been suspended from active police work and is under internal investigation. When Sara, his internet love affair, goes missing, he decides to drive to her town in Bahia, in search of her.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programme.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programme.title: Instant Italian
programme.desc: Anna's throwing an Italian Snacking Party and showing how to make her guests' favorite make-ahead snacks, such as Sicilian-style Chicken Spiedini and Neapolitan Fried Eggplant Sandwiches.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Usa
programme.desc: Bill and Paul ride into their hometown of Bryan-College Station Texas, where the town is being over run by Wild Boars. They head out on a night hunt with state-of-the-art military-grade equipment and Bill bags a big pig. Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.title: Jamie's Super Food
programme.desc: On the Greek island of Ikaria Jamie finds out how wholegrain cracked wheat- which could be one of the reasons local people live so long - is prepared the traditional way and helps make Trahana.

programme.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
programme.sub-title: Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar
programme.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me: The Professionals
programme.desc: Today we're in and around Birmingham and Wolverhampton and first up is Adians Dining where chef Adian and fiance and front of house manager Eloise are showcasing their Caribbean-Asian fusion menu.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Fillers
programme.desc: Hosts Adam Liaw, Renee Lim and Lily Serna meet passionate growers, celebrated chefs and local food heroes from all over Australia.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a night of sensational seafood as Adam and his world-class guests, swimmer Ariarne Titmus and chef Alejandro Saravia, share how they reel in a crowd.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk. However, until quite recently, the only specialist cheeses available in the country came from Europe.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia
programme.desc: Adam and Meik Wiking, the Director of The Happiness Institute, together cook the national Danish dish, Stegt Flaesk, and discuss how Denmark is the happiest country in the world. Adam ventures into top chef Christian Puglisi's kitchen at Michelin star restaurant Relae, before visiting a pastry chef to make a traditional Danish pastry, Spandauer. Adam shares this treat with author Michael Booth who gives him an insight into the differences between the Nordic countries.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Global food explorer Adam is touring Britain, one incredible, edible place at a time, using the map as his menu to try the best food found here. He’s travelled to Scone in Scotland for a taste of the tattie scone. He also visits a top restaurant in Perth for Scotland's national dish, the famous haggis, neeps and tatties.

programme.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programme.desc: Buddy makes a cake for an old friend and the current Editorial Director of House Beautiful Magazine, Joanna Saltz. Meanwhile, when Danny The Mule announces his retirement.

programme.sub-title: Chilli Crab, Chilli Fish, Fried Rice, Shellfish Salad

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: In this episode, Rachel is coming in strong with this flavorful Pork Chop Pizzaiola recipe made with blistered tomatoes, onions and garlic cooked a la plancha style.

Julian is determined to tell her how he feels on the next trip, but an error when choosing the remaining occupants of the car will find him lumbered with a very unsettling fourth passenger, whose presence will bring about a radical change in the course of events.

programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!

programme.title: Banel & Adama

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Cormac McCarthy, violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon some dead bodies, a stash of heroin and more than $2 million in cash near the Rio Grande. Winner of four Academy Awards in 2008, including Best Director and Best Film. Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, and stars Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin.

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.
